cities.title: Wedding Anchor & Event Host in Ahmedabad
cities.metaTitle: Wedding Anchor & Event Host in Ahmedabad — Manav Joshi
cities.metaDesc: Ahmedabad-based wedding anchor and corporate emcee. 250+ shows. Gujarati, Hindi and English. Sangeet, reception, brand events and conferences.
cities.lede: Ahmedabad is home. Most of my 250+ shows happened within an hour of this city — sangeets in Bodakdev farmhouses, brand nights at Karnavati Club, Navratri stages, conferences at the convention centres off SG Highway. If your event is here, I have almost certainly worked your venue, and I can meet you in person before I take the mic.
cities.langs: Gujarati, Hindi and English, all three at native comfort. In Ahmedabad that usually means Gujarati for the family, Hindi for the crowd and English for the corporate line — switched inside the same sentence when the room needs it.
cities.logistics: Local. No travel or stay to budget for, and I can do a venue recce and a family meeting before the date without it costing you anything.

faqs.q: How much does a wedding anchor cost in Ahmedabad?
faqs.a: It depends on the number of functions, the length of the day and how much script work the event needs. Message me on WhatsApp with your dates and I will give you a number the same day — no packages, no per-head maths.

faqs.q: Do you host sangeet in Gujarati?
faqs.a: Yes. Gujarati, Hindi and English with native proficiency, and I move between them live depending on who is standing in front of the stage.

faqs.q: How far in advance should I book?
faqs.a: For a wedding, a month of lead time is what makes the difference — that is when I sit down with the couple and build the script, the games and the bits out of your actual story rather than a template.

faqs.q: Do you host corporate events in Ahmedabad too?
faqs.a: Yes, and it is a big part of the work. I spent eight years as a marketer, four of them at Red Bull, so I read a run of show the way your brand team does.

cities.title: Wedding Anchor & Corporate Emcee in Surat
cities.metaTitle: Wedding Anchor & Corporate Emcee in Surat — Manav Joshi
cities.metaDesc: Wedding and corporate host for Surat events. Gujarati, Hindi and English. Sangeet, reception, diamond and textile industry brand nights. Travels from Ahmedabad.
cities.lede: Surat weddings are big, loud and family-heavy, and Surat corporate nights — diamond, textile, real estate — are run by people who know exactly what they are paying for. Both want the same thing from a host: someone who can hold a very large room without shouting at it. I come up from Ahmedabad for these.
cities.langs: Gujarati and Hindi carry most of a Surat room, with English for the corporate segments. Surat is mixed enough — Saurashtrian, Marwari, Bhojpuri, South Gujarat — that a host who only speaks one of those loses half the floor.
cities.logistics: A few hours up the highway from Ahmedabad, or the train. Day events I travel for the same day; multi-function weddings I stay over. Travel and stay are billed at cost, never marked up.

faqs.q: Do you travel to Surat for weddings?
faqs.a: Yes. I am based in Ahmedabad and Surat is a regular run. Travel and stay are billed at cost.

faqs.q: Can you host a Surat sangeet in Gujarati and Hindi together?
faqs.a: Yes — that is usually what the room needs. Gujarati for the family, Hindi for the wider crowd, and I switch live rather than picking one and hoping.

faqs.q: Do you do corporate events in Surat?
faqs.a: Yes. Dealer nights, product launches, award evenings. I was a marketer for eight years before this, four at Red Bull, so the brand side of a run of show is not new ground.

cities.title: Wedding Anchor & Event Host in Vadodara
cities.metaTitle: Wedding Anchor & Event Host in Vadodara (Baroda) — Manav Joshi
cities.metaDesc: Wedding anchor and corporate emcee for Vadodara and Baroda events. Gujarati, Hindi, English. Sangeet, reception, corporate and Navratri stages.
cities.lede: Vadodara is a two-hour drive and a genuinely different room from Ahmedabad — more Marathi and English in the mix, a strong corporate base, and an audience that has seen good stagecraft and notices when it is missing. I host weddings, corporate evenings and festival stages here.
cities.langs: Gujarati, Hindi and English. Baroda rooms tend to carry more English than Ahmedabad ones, and a good number of Marathi families, so the register sits a little lighter on Gujarati than it would in Rajkot.
cities.logistics: Close enough to drive down and back in a day. For multi-function weddings I stay for the run. Travel billed at cost.

faqs.q: Do you host weddings in Vadodara?
faqs.a: Yes, regularly. It is a short drive from my base in Ahmedabad, so a single-function booking is easy to take.

faqs.q: Which languages do you host in?
faqs.a: Gujarati, Hindi and English at native proficiency, switched live to match the room.

faqs.q: Can you host a corporate conference in Baroda?
faqs.a: Yes. Conferences, award nights, launches and dealer meets. Eight years in marketing before hosting became the job.

cities.title: Wedding Anchor & Emcee in Rajkot
cities.metaTitle: Wedding Anchor & Emcee in Rajkot, Saurashtra — Manav Joshi
cities.metaDesc: Gujarati wedding anchor for Rajkot and Saurashtra. Sangeet, reception, garba and corporate events. Native Gujarati, Hindi and English. Travels from Ahmedabad.
cities.lede: Rajkot and the wider Saurashtra belt run on Gujarati, and they run warm — the family is the show, not the backdrop. A host who treats a Kathiawadi sangeet like a Bombay corporate gig dies on that stage. I host these in Gujarati first, and I keep the family on the mic more than most anchors are comfortable with.
cities.langs: Gujarati first, with Hindi and English available for the guests who need them. In Saurashtra the Gujarati has to be real — read-off-a-card Gujarati is heard instantly.
cities.logistics: A few hours from Ahmedabad by road. Same-day for single functions, staying over for a full wedding run. Travel at cost.

faqs.q: Do you host Gujarati weddings in Rajkot?
faqs.a: Yes. Gujarati is a native language for me, not a second one, which matters more in Saurashtra than almost anywhere else in the state.

faqs.q: Do you travel to Rajkot and Saurashtra?
faqs.a: Yes — Rajkot, Jamnagar, Junagadh, Bhavnagar and the towns around them. I am based in Ahmedabad and travel is billed at cost.

faqs.q: Can you host garba nights?
faqs.a: Yes. Festival and garba stages are part of the regular calendar.

cities.title: Destination Wedding Host in Udaipur
cities.metaTitle: Destination Wedding Host & Anchor in Udaipur — Manav Joshi
cities.metaDesc: Destination wedding anchor for Udaipur. Gujarati, Hindi and English host who travels with the family from Ahmedabad. Sangeet, mehendi, reception across a multi-day run.
cities.lede: Most Udaipur weddings are not Udaipur weddings. The family is from Ahmedabad, Surat, Mumbai or Delhi; the city is the venue. That is a specific job: three or four days, guests who have flown in and do not know each other, and a host who has to knit a room together fast. I travel with the family for these, which is the point — you get a host who already knows your people, not one who meets them at the mandap.
cities.langs: Gujarati, Hindi and English. For a Gujarati or Marwari family marrying in Udaipur, that mix is the whole reason to bring your own host instead of hiring locally — the jokes land in the language the family actually laughs in.
cities.logistics: Udaipur is a straightforward drive or a short flight from Ahmedabad, and for a multi-day wedding I am there for the full run rather than flying in per function. Travel and stay billed at cost.

faqs.q: Do you travel to Udaipur for destination weddings?
faqs.a: Yes. I am based in Ahmedabad and travel for the full run of a destination wedding rather than per function. Travel and stay are billed at cost, never marked up.

faqs.q: Why bring a host from Gujarat instead of hiring in Udaipur?
faqs.a: Because most Udaipur weddings are hosted for families who are not from Udaipur. If your family laughs in Gujarati, a host who works in Gujarati, Hindi and English is doing a different job from a local anchor working in Hindi alone — and I meet the couple a month before, so the script comes out of your story.

faqs.q: How many days do you stay for?
faqs.a: The whole run. A destination wedding is a single event spread over days, and the third night only works if the host was on the first one.

faqs.q: Do you host corporate offsites in Udaipur?
faqs.a: Yes. Offsites, conferences and award nights, in English and Hindi.

cities.title: Wedding Anchor & Corporate Host in Jaipur
cities.metaTitle: Wedding Anchor & Corporate Event Host in Jaipur — Manav Joshi
cities.metaDesc: Anchor and emcee for Jaipur weddings, destination weddings and corporate conferences. Hindi, Gujarati and English. Travels from Ahmedabad for the full run.
cities.lede: Jaipur takes two kinds of booking: the destination wedding where the family flew in, and the corporate conference where the company did. Both are rooms of people who do not know each other yet, in a city none of them live in. That is the room I am built for — I open it, name it, and give people a reason to talk to the stranger next to them.
cities.langs: Hindi and English lead a Jaipur room, with Gujarati in reserve for Gujarati families marrying here — which is a large share of the destination weddings the city hosts.
cities.logistics: A short flight from Ahmedabad, or a long drive. For a wedding I come for the full run, not per function. Travel and stay billed at cost.

faqs.q: Do you take Jaipur bookings?
faqs.a: Yes. I am based in Ahmedabad and travel for weddings and corporate events across Rajasthan. Travel and stay are billed at cost.

faqs.q: Can you host in Hindi and English?
faqs.a: Both, at native proficiency, plus Gujarati — which matters if the family marrying in Jaipur is Gujarati, as many are.

faqs.q: Do you host corporate conferences?
faqs.a: Yes, and it is a large part of the work. Eight years as a marketer before this, four at Red Bull, plus brand events for Mercedes, Toyota, Canon and Intel.

cities.title: Destination Wedding Anchor in Jodhpur
cities.metaTitle: Destination Wedding Anchor & Emcee in Jodhpur — Manav Joshi
cities.metaDesc: Wedding anchor for Jodhpur destination weddings and corporate events. Hindi, Gujarati, English. Travels from Ahmedabad and stays for the full multi-day run.
cities.lede: Jodhpur weddings are built around the setting — forts, courtyards, long evenings that start late. A host working that kind of venue has to hold a crowd that is spread out and distracted by the view, which is a different skill from holding a banquet hall. I come from Ahmedabad and stay for the full run.
cities.langs: Hindi first, with English for the out-of-town guests and Gujarati for Gujarati families — a common pairing in Jodhpur destination weddings.
cities.logistics: A drive or a short hop from Ahmedabad. Multi-day weddings mean I stay across the functions. Travel and stay at cost.

faqs.q: Do you travel to Jodhpur?
faqs.a: Yes, from Ahmedabad, and I stay for the full run of a multi-day wedding rather than flying in per function.

faqs.q: Which languages do you host in?
faqs.a: Hindi, Gujarati and English, all three at native comfort, switched live to match the room.

faqs.q: What makes a fort or palace wedding different to host?
faqs.a: The crowd spreads out and the venue competes with you. You win those rooms by pulling people in tight for the moments that matter instead of trying to shout across the courtyard.

cities.title: Wedding Anchor & Corporate Emcee in Indore

cities.langs: Hindi leads, with Gujarati for the Gujarati and Marwari families who make up a large part of Indore's business community, and English for the corporate segments.
cities.logistics: A short flight or a long drive from Ahmedabad. Single-function bookings and full wedding runs both work. Travel and stay billed at cost.

faqs.q: Do you take bookings in Indore and Madhya Pradesh?
faqs.a: Yes. I am based in Ahmedabad and travel for weddings and corporate events. Travel and stay are billed at cost.

faqs.q: Do you host in Hindi?
faqs.a: Yes — Hindi, Gujarati and English, all at native proficiency.

faqs.q: Have you hosted events of this size before?
faqs.a: 250+ live shows, from rooms of twenty to crowds of twenty-five thousand, including stages with Shaan, Amit Trivedi, DIVINE and Nucleya, and brand events for Red Bull, Mercedes, Toyota, Canon and Intel.

cities.title: Wedding Anchor & Event Host in Bhopal
cities.metaTitle: Wedding Anchor & Event Host in Bhopal, MP — Manav Joshi
cities.metaDesc: Wedding anchor and corporate emcee available for Bhopal events. Hindi, Gujarati, English. 250+ shows, 7 Indian states. Travels from Ahmedabad.
cities.lede: Bhopal takes weddings and government-and-corporate evenings in roughly equal measure, and both reward a host who can be genuinely funny without ever being loose. That balance — warm, quick, never at anyone's expense — is the whole job description. I travel here from Ahmedabad.
cities.langs: Hindi first, English for the formal and corporate segments, Gujarati where the family calls for it.
cities.logistics: A flight or a long drive from Ahmedabad. Worth booking as a full-run stay for a multi-function wedding. Travel and stay at cost.

faqs.q: Do you travel to Bhopal?
faqs.a: Yes, from Ahmedabad. Travel and stay are billed at cost, never marked up.

faqs.q: Which languages do you host in?
faqs.a: Hindi, Gujarati and English at native proficiency.

faqs.q: How do I check your dates?
faqs.a: Message me on WhatsApp with the date and the city. I answer the same day.
